title: Birthdays by month
statementMd:
How many students were born in each calendar month (01-12)? Show the month number and count.

Expected columns: `month`, `students`.

Tables: `teachers`, `courses`, `students`, `enrollments`.

Row order does not matter.
solutionMd:
```sql
SELECT strftime('%m', birth_date) AS month, COUNT(*) AS students FROM students GROUP BY month;
```

Compare with your own query; the result sets must match.
